description: This file contains utility functions within the org.example.utilities package, specifically for splitting a string into tokens and adding valid tokens to a linked list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A Kotlin object providing utility functions for splitting strings into tokens and managing linked list insertions.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a LinkedList of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the linked list if it is considered valid.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is not empty and thus valid.
